title: Stage 1 research universe specification (candidate list, eligibility rules, exclusions)
note: This file contains no timestamp by design; see governance/STAGE_1_PREREGISTRATION.json.

scope_decision.constitutional_basis: SE100-GOV-0001 section 6: a static present-day stock list may not be used to make historical claims without an explicit survivorship-bias verdict, and a dataset that cannot support the required bias controls may still support ETF-only research if that narrower use is frozen before strategy results are viewed.
why_stocks_are_excluded: The selected provider supplies no point-in-time index-membership history, so historical universe membership cannot be reconstructed.
The selected provider supplies no reliable delisted-security coverage, so companies that failed, merged, or were acquired are absent from any present-day list.
Backtesting a present-day stock list over history would therefore embed an uncontrolled and unquantifiable upward survivorship bias.
No paid data source is authorized, so the bias cannot be controlled by buying better data.
The constitution's own remedy for exactly this situation is to narrow prospectively to ETF-only research, which is what is done here.
scope_decision.narrowing_is_permitted: This narrows scope relative to the constitution's Generation 1 securities definition. Narrowing is always permitted; only weakening is forbidden.

etf_universe_bias_assessment.honest_statement: The candidate list below was assembled in 2026 and therefore contains only funds that still exist in 2026. Exchange-traded funds that launched and later closed between the start of the development window and the data cutoff are absent from it. This is a real residual survivorship bias and it is not eliminated by the ETF narrowing.
why_the_residual_is_smaller_than_the_sto: Every candidate is a large, broad, rules-based index fund from a major sponsor, a category in which closure over the sample period was rare rather than typical.
Fund closures overwhelmingly affect small, narrow, recently launched, or thematic products; the inception cutoff below excludes that entire population by construction.
The candidate list is fixed and small, so the selection cannot be quietly expanded later to add whatever happened to perform well.
etf_universe_bias_assessment.what_would_be_required_to_quantify_it: A delisted-fund database with point-in-time listing status. None is available at zero cost, so the bias is disclosed rather than measured.
etf_universe_bias_assessment.binding_consequence: Every downstream result carries this limitation in its report. No Stage 1 artifact may claim the ETF universe is survivorship-free.

eligibility_rules.evaluated: mechanically, after acquisition, from the frozen rules below; no discretionary addition or removal is permitted

structural.rule: listed on a US national securities exchange
no leveraged exposure of any multiple
does not issue a Schedule K-1; commodity pools and partnerships are excluded
physical-commodity grantor trusts are excluded; see excluded_by_construction
tracks a published rules-based index rather than a discretionary mandate
first available trading session on or before 2010-01-04

measured_on_development_window_only.rule: at least 1260 trading sessions inside the development window (about five years)
median of close * volume over the development window is at least USD 5000000
minimum close over the development window is at least USD 5.00
passes every FAIL-severity check in the validation battery

eligibility_rules.measurement_window_restriction: No eligibility measurement may read validation-window or holdout-window data. This is a hard rule and is enforced by test, not by convention.

broker_eligibility.reason: No credential access is authorized at Stage 1.
broker_eligibility.binding_consequence: The realized universe is conditional. Any symbol later found non-tradable or non-fractionable at Alpaca must be removed and every affected gate re-run.

excluded_by_construction.reason: Constitution section 3 defines the securities scope as US-listed common stocks and unleveraged ETFs. A physical-metal grantor trust is not a registered investment company and is not literally an ETF. Stage 1 declines to widen a frozen scope by interpretation. Adding this class would require a new constitution version, not a Stage 1 decision.
Prohibited by the NOT_K1_PARTNERSHIP rule and operationally unsuitable for a USD 100 cash account.
See scope_decision: survivorship bias is uncontrolled for this provider.

candidate_selection_provenance.how_chosen: Asset-class coverage first, then the oldest and largest fund available for each exposure. Coverage spans US broad equity, the nine original US sector funds, the Treasury curve, credit, inflation-linked, developed and emerging international equity, real estate, and dividend factors.
candidate_selection_provenance.duplication_is_intentional: Several near-duplicate exposures are included on purpose (IVV/SPY, VEA/EFA, VWO/EEM, AGG/BND). They are a redundancy control: two funds tracking the same exposure from different sponsors give an independent cross-check on data quality that a single-provider feed otherwise cannot supply.

reference_symbols.range_rationale: Restricted to the development window so that no validation-window or holdout-window data is touched by a data-quality fixture.

symbols.why: Two large, unambiguous, independently documented splits inside the development window. A split of this size makes an adjustment error impossible to miss.
